As the petition involves the same facts, they are being decided by this common judgment and order. 2. Shorn of unnecessary details, the facts of the present matter are as follows: i. Upon receiving a reference from the Department of Steel and Mines, Govt. of Odisha, State Vigilance officials conducted an enquiry and joint physical verification of the Uliburu Mines area from 01.07.2013 to 04.07.2013, subsequently a First Information Report (hereinafter referred to as 'FIR') was lodged on 27.07.2013 against the present petitioners and a host of officials of the Mining, Forest and Revenue Departments of the State of Odisha, alleging illegal mining and removal of iron ore from the Uliburu Iron Ore Mines as well as from the surrounding Uliburu Reserve Forest area. ii.
